svg.title: Bar schedule layout
svg.desc: A coordinated sample bar schedule with twelve marked entries, bending-shape diagrams, example quantities and drawing references.
svg.text: EXAMPLE QUANTITIES / DIMENSIONS BEFORE BENDING ADJUSTMENTS
Refer to beam and column studies for drawing-reference context.
MARK links the bar to a drawing.
DIA. is the example bar diameter in mm.
A and B describe the sketch dimensions.
Shape sketches are not fabrication details.
No steel order may be based on this sheet.
